sources.title: Models & Pricing
sources.facts: Current direct model IDs deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro; versions V4.1-Flash-1017 and V4-Pro-0813; both thinking/non-thinking; 1M context and 384K max output. Flash cheaper than Pro. Old Flash IDs route to latest Flash.

sources.title: Lists Models
sources.facts: Documented metadata example gives context_window=1048576 and max_output_tokens=393216 for both current models. Not a live authenticated account availability check.

sources.title: Change Log
sources.facts: 2026-10-17 updates Flash to 1017 through unchanged deepseek-flash ID. September10 entry explicitly continues V4 Pro service after September14, contradicting retirement wording in launch news. Legacy deepseek-chat/reasoner were scheduled discontinued July24.

sources.title: Thinking Mode
sources.facts: Default thinking enabled, high effort. ChatCompletions thinking enabled/disabled plus reasoning_effort low/high/max. Responses reasoning.effort none/low/high/max. Temperature ignored in thinking mode.

sources.title: Chat Completions API
sources.facts: response_format documents json_object, no json_schema. max_tokens cap393216; defaults nonthinking8192, thinking65536, thinking max131072. Total input+generated tokens bounded by context.

sources.title: JSON Output
sources.facts: Guarantees JSON syntax, requires json in prompt and adequate output budget; occasionally empty content. JSON object mode is not exact schema enforcement.

sources.title: Responses API
sources.facts: text.format type json_schema with required name/schema documented as conforming to schema; both current IDs accepted. No strict flag or supported subset specified there. reasoning effort none/low/high/max. max_output_tokens includes reasoning and visible tokens.

sources.title: Tool Calls strict Beta
sources.facts: Beta base_url /beta plus function.strict=true enforces supported function schema in both modes. All object properties required; additionalProperties=false. minItems/maxItems and minLength/maxLength unsupported. Numeric minimum/maximum supported.
